hero.title: New furnished suites, a short walk from Salalah Gardens Mall
hero.lead: A sitting room, a kitchen and a quiet bedroom of your own: for a family holiday, a khareef week or a longer stay.

rooms.intro: Each suite has two bedrooms, a sitting room, a kitchen and two bathrooms; the apartments have a bedroom, a sitting room, a kitchen and a bathroom; and there are rooms with a bathroom of their own. Pick what suits you and tell us your dates.
rooms.stay: By the night, the week or longer: ask us
rooms.bathroomText: A fridge, a gas cooker with an oven, a sink and a washing machine in the suites and apartments; a kettle and a small fridge in the deluxe rooms. Layouts vary from unit to unit, so tell us what you need.

suite.name: The suite
suite.short: Two bedrooms, sitting room, kitchen, two bathrooms
suite.desc: Two bedrooms, one with a wide double bed and one with two single beds, each with its own bathroom. Between them a sitting room with a sofa, an armchair and a wall-mounted TV, and a kitchen with a cooker, an oven, a fridge and a washing machine. For a family or two couples.
steps: The sitting room, with the doors to both bedrooms
The first bedroom: a wide double bed
The second bedroom: two single beds
The kitchen: cooker, oven, fridge and washing machine

apartment.name: One-bedroom apartment
apartment.desc: One bedroom with a double bed under a lit panelled wall, a sitting room with a sofa and a TV, a kitchen with a dining table, and a bathroom. A small home for a couple or a long stay.
steps: The bedroom under the lit headboard wall
The sitting room with the sofa and the TV
The kitchen and the dining table

studio.name: Studio
studio.desc: One room with the beds and a TV, a small sitting corner and a bathroom of its own. No kitchen: the mall's cafés and restaurants are a few minutes on foot.
steps: The beds, with the TV in the same room
The sitting corner by the window

deluxe.name: Deluxe room
deluxe.desc: A bedroom with a wide double bed and a gold runner, a kitchenette with a kettle and a small fridge, and a bathroom. For one or two guests on a short stay.
steps: The double bed with the gold runner
The kitchenette: a kettle and a small fridge

clean.d: “Clean new apartments”, in one guest's words. The suites were renovated recently and it shows.

host.d: Guests name the host in their reviews. Write on WhatsApp and you deal with a person.

location.d: Salalah Gardens Mall and the Chinese Village are a few minutes on foot; the airport is a short drive.

kitchen.d: The suites and apartments have a full kitchen with a washing machine; the deluxe rooms a kettle and a fridge. Breakfast and late dinners are yours.

parking.d: Park by the building at no charge: handy for a hire car in khareef.

wifi.d: In every unit, with a smart TV.

renovation.title: Not a room: a small home
renovation.text: A bedroom with the door closed, a sitting room where the children can watch TV, a kitchen for the morning coffee and a washing machine for a long trip. That's the difference between a suite and a hotel room, and why families stay here.

gallery.intro: Swipe through the bedrooms, the sitting rooms, the kitchens, the reception and the building by the mall.

khareef.now: It's khareef season — Salalah's hills are green and the mist is in.
khareef.later: Next khareef: late June to the end of August.

salalah.intro: Salalah is the only part of the Arabian Peninsula with a monsoon season in summer: the khareef, from late June to the end of August. The rest of the year it is known for its stunning coast of soft white sand and clear blue water. From the suites, the mall is a walk and the rest is a short drive.
salalah.byAir: From Salalah Airport: a short taxi ride.
salalah.byBus: From the bus station: a short taxi ride west.
salalah.byRoad: By road from Muscat: around 10 hours on the Route 31 highway.
